name: 9Router Monitor
author: jhonoryza
description: Navbar pill for the 9Router dashboard: pulses while a model request is in flight, shows the last-used model when idle, and handles dashboard login (with a password prompt UI) when the session expires.

barWidget.description: Live model-request indicator for the 9Router dashboard

schema.label: Dashboard base URL
schema.description: Scheme + host + port of the 9Router dashboard, without a trailing slash.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to ask the dashboard for active and recent model requests.

schema.label: Show model name in the bar
schema.description: Off leaves only the activity dot, for a narrower pill.

schema.label: Remember dashboard password
schema.description: Keeps the dashboard password in the login keyring so an expired session re-authenticates on its own. Off means typing it again every time the session expires.
